summary: Backend-only validation of Featured Workouts v2 (6 picks) seed + endpoints. All 13 pytest tests passed against the live preview backend. Auto-seed log confirmed replacement on startup. Endpoints exercised: GET /api/featured/bundle, GET /api/featured/config, POST /api/featured/workouts/batch.

minor.issue: Backend logged 'SLOW REQUEST: GET /api/featured/bundle took 904.27ms' on the cold call. Subsequent calls are fast (cached/warm). Worth monitoring.

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/featured/workouts/batch accepts a raw JSON array body (FastAPI signature `ids: List[str]`). This is non-conventional and easy to misuse — clients sending `{"ids": [...]}` get a 422. Consider wrapping in a Pydantic model `{ids: List[str]}` for a more discoverable contract; current frontend likely already adapts, but worth documenting.

Auto-seed performs full replace (delete + insert) when title-set differs. Idempotent path (already-seeded) correctly short-circuits — verified via second restart log: 'Featured workouts already seeded (6 found, correct titles)'.
Bar to Floor hero deliberately uses legacy URL (job_fit-outdoor-views/.../pu.avif) — flagged in seed_data.py with a TODO comment. Pending user-provided asset replacement.
server.py is 12,917 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Recommend modularization (separate routers per domain) when feasible.
test_credentials: Not required — featured endpoints are public.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Verified auto-seed produced the 6 canonical v2 workouts as defined in /app/backend/seed_data.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Featured Workouts v2 backend is healthy. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_featured_workouts_v2.py is reusable as a regression suite for future seed updates. NOTE: POST /api/featured/workouts/batch expects a raw JSON array body (not {ids:[...]}), the test now sends `json=ids` directly. Frontend cart sub-path divider rendering (cart.tsx, featured-workout-detail.tsx) was NOT tested in this run — main agent should validate UI separately if needed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no production bugs found. Two initial test failures were tester-side payload format issues fixed in test_featured_workouts_v2.py (raw List[str] body instead of {ids: List[str]} object).
